annotations.text:
A · Sketch grid — the attached sketch, literally.
Two by two at every width, screenshots tilted and broken out of the card top. Reads as a toy shelf.
Tradeoff: at 390px the two-up cards leave ~150px of text width, so the blurbs have to be short — that is the least SEO copy of the three.

B · Marquee row — four abreast, editorial hero.
Left-aligned hero so the h1 and the paragraph read as one block; cards straight-on and equal weight.
Tradeoff: four equal cards say all four tools are equally real. Three of them are not.

C · Featured — the shipped tool leads.
The dex builder gets a split hero card with a real screenshot and a solid CTA; the other three sit in a supporting row.
Tradeoff: it buries the league builder, which is the tool with a settled spec and the next page to rank.

SEO structure, same in all three:
· h1 carries "make your own Pokédex" plus region and league.
· Each card is an <h2> that exactly matches its slug: /custom-pokedex-builder, /pokemon-league-builder, /favorite-pokemon-picker.
· The footer repeats the four links as anchor text.
Watch out: making / a router moves the dex builder off the URL that ranks today (~pos 7.8 for "pokedex builder").

D · Poster cards. The card is described once as ratios of its own width and scaled per breakpoint, so desktop is the mobile card enlarged rather than a differently proportioned one — that is what removes the extra red to the right of the screenshots on desktop.
Screenshots are re-cropped to a real phone viewport, 390x844, so they read tall and narrow instead of squat.
The fourth card takes the app's own lucide Hammer, in white, sized to sit wholly inside the red.

Two numbers that are at their ceiling, so you know which way they move.
The LEFT OVERHANG is small — about 10px at 390. The gradient stops at the card's left edge, so it has to finish before the artwork starts hanging off to the left, and a wider overhang pushes that crossing lower and squeezes the gradient. Wider overhang means a steeper fan or less copy.
The CLEAR BAND on desktop is 29%, not the 33% asked for. At 900px the space below the header is 850px; the hero and the card block together need about 400px, which leaves 225px each side. 33% would need the content under 289px — reachable by dropping the second hero paragraph or shrinking the cards toward mobile size.
